meta.name: linkedin-interviewer
meta.description: Interview the user for the raw material their posts are made of. Builds a lasting Story Bank of roles, numbers, turning points, scars and positions, or runs a focused interview that turns one topic into a post spine. Use when a draft has nothing concrete to draw on, or the user says interview me. Not for learning how they write (use linkedin-humanizer --mode profile).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过追问挖出你的真实经历,攒成随手可用的写作素材库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常想发帖,却觉得没什么具体经历可写。
copy.tagline_en: Turn your real experiences into a lasting bank of story material for posts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to post often but feel you have nothing concrete to write about.

howto.what: Claude 会像记者一样采访你,把具体素材(数字、日期、转折、立场)整理成一份可复用的 Story Bank 文件;也可就单个话题做 5~8 问的聚焦采访,产出文章骨架。答不上来的地方它会留空,不替你编。
howto.when: 当你说「采访我」「问我问题」,或写作技能发现 Story Bank 是空的、草稿缺具体素材时接管。学写作风格请用 linkedin-humanizer --mode profile。

say.text: 采访我,帮我把能写的东西整理成 Story Bank
say.note: 开始 20~40 分钟的完整采访

say.text: 就「远程团队管理」这个话题采访我,5 到 8 个问题
say.note: 产出文章骨架,交给 post-writer

say.text: 我换了新工作,帮我更新一下 Story Bank
say.note: 只补薄弱部分,不重复提问

howto.what_en: Claude interviews you for the concrete material your posts need — numbers, dates, turning points, positions — and saves your answers in a reusable Story Bank file. Or it runs a short interview on one topic and returns a post spine.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "interview me" or "ask me questions", when a writing skill finds the Story Bank empty, or when a draft has no concrete material. Not for learning your writing style.

say_en.text: Interview me and build my Story Bank from what I have.
Interview me on remote team management, 5 to 8 questions.
say_en.note: Ends in a post spine for the writer

say_en.text: I changed roles — update my Story Bank.
